title: Add black and blue theme pairs; move emerald day to Django Smooth
description: Port Ghostty Chalk + Gruvbox Dark Hard as the 'black' pair, Blue Dolphin + Hivacruz as the 'blue' pair, and replace django with django-smooth in the emerald day slot. mini.base16 ports in colors/, contrast floors per docs/specs/theme-pairs.md, docs updated.
close_reason: Ports landed in colors/, pair table + docs updated, lint/test pass, all 10 schemes load headlessly

title: kulala: persistent scratchpad file behind <leader>Rb
description: kulala's kulala://scratchpad buffer resets to scratchpad_default_contents on every open (ui/init.lua:664-668), cannot be written (:w fails with E212, no BufWriteCmd), and is force-deleted on session load (vim-sessions.lua:31-51). Override <leader>Rb to open a real file under stdpath('data') instead, seeded with kulala's default contents on first use.
close_reason: <leader>Rb now opens stdpath(data)/kulala-scratchpad.http, seeded on first use; docs updated

title: kulala: auto-unfold response body and add JSON→YAML view
description: The kulala response window uses foldmethod=indent with the default foldlevel=0, so pretty-printed JSON bodies open fully collapsed. Also, kulala 6.29.0 dropped the contenttypes.formatter render hook (only pathresolver survives, used by parser/request_variables.lua), so there is no config switch to view JSON responses as YAML. Add ui.win_opts.wo.foldlevel=99 for auto-unfold, and a <leader>Ry keymap that pipes kulala's BODY_FILE through yq into a scratch yaml buffer.
close_reason: Added ui.win_opts.wo.foldlevel=99 and a <leader>Ry yq-backed YAML view; docs updated
